messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a federal holiday that falls on a Monday, Friday, or that is observed on a Monday/Friday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1–3** (Sunday–Tuesday) |
| Family Day (Ontario, BC, etc.) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 20–22** (Mon–Wed) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **May 22–24** (Mon–Wed) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) – observed on Friday, Jul 1 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 4–6** (Mon–Wed) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 9–11** (Mon–Wed) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Monday | **Nov 11–13** (Mon–Wed) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 25–27** (Mon–Wed) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | **Dec 26–28** (Tue–Thu) – no extended weekend |

**Key points for planning:**

- **Observed days:** When a holiday falls on a weekend, the federal rule is to observe it on the nearest weekday (usually the preceding Friday).  
- **Regional variations:** Some holidays (e.g., Family Day) are only observed in certain provinces; the above list reflects the federal holidays that apply nationwide.  
- **Extended weekends:** For holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, the weekend itself (Saturday & Sunday) is part of the long weekend.  

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need more detailed regional holiday data or want to include provincial holidays, let me know!
